description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of RPG (Repetition Problem Generation) applied to LLMs (Large Language Models) of different sizes, specifically CodeLlama-7B and CodeLlama-34B, across four metrics: EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP. The vertical axis represents performance, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, while the horizontal axis lists the metrics. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the two LLM sizes: blue for CodeLlama-7B and orange for CodeLlama-34B. The chart shows that for EGP, CodeLlama-7B outperforms CodeLlama-34B, while for TR-N and TR-S, the performance is similar for both sizes. In the CCP metric, CodeLlama-34B shows a higher performance than CodeLlama-7B. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars, and no additional annotations or visual effects are present.
